description: Fixture-only validation of one operator-supplied Kentucky SOS company-family tab-delimited file; officer files are forbidden.
redirect_policy: No HTTP requests or redirects are permitted.
retry: No automatic retry; explicitly replace or correct the local package.
checkpoint: Read-only validation returns an in-memory local-review projection and writes no release, admission, enrollment, or pointer.
idempotency: The fixed source filename, SHA-256, byte size, row count, header declaration, temporal scope, and transformation version identify an inspection.
cancellation: Abort cooperatively before and during parsing; no output artifact exists to clean up.
retention_profile: Raw company-family input is person-bearing/internal; minimized normalized output remains local-review-only pending rights review.
